notes: US-market Mitsubishi Eclipse coupe and Spyder only. The Plymouth Laser (1990-1994) and Eagle Talon (1990-1998) used the same engines (1G 1.8/2.0/2.0T; 2G 420A and 4G63T) on the shared Diamond-Star D platform but are not recorded here.

Source rule: all Mitsubishi material (MMNA releases, Mitsubishi Canada) = one source; Wikipedia one; EPA one (displacement/cylinders/turbo only); Consumer Guide, Cars.com, KBB, MotorWeek one each. NHRA has no Eclipse rows.
HP is SAE net. Turbo and some base engines carried separate manual/automatic ratings: hp_manual / hp_auto fields.
Engine code in rpo. The 4G Eclipse 2.4 is the 4G69, not the 4G64.
US 2G cars never got the NA 4G63 (European GS only).
